caption: The drawing depicts a beige or light brown ceramic jug with a wide mouth, two small handles on either side of the neck, and a rounded body that narrows slightly toward the base. On the front of the jug, there is a cobalt blue decorative design consisting of two stylized flowers with spiral-shaped petals and large, elongated leaves, both connected by a single stem. Above the floral motif, there is blue text that appears to read "HARRISBURG PA." and a number. The jug's mouth has a thick, rounded rim, and the handles are looped and attached near the upper third of the vessel. The background of the drawing is a plain, cream or off-white color with no additional objects or details. The artist's signature, "E. Bose," is written at the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Crock
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
